step_by_step_approach: Identify the loss rate values for items in the veg whsle data set.
Calculate the average of those loss rates.
Calculate the standard deviation of those loss rates.
Determine the lower bound as one standard deviation below the average.
Determine the upper bound as one standard deviation above the average.
Count the items whose loss rates are below the lower bound.
Count the items whose loss rates fall between the lower and upper bounds.
Count the items whose loss rates are above the upper bound.
Combine the average loss rate and the three counts into a summary.
